name: effect-dag-sync-quality

protocol.note: All 4 sub-cases run through a single MTLCommandBuffer per submit() call. fork-join's 4 passes all write the same allocation with mutually-conflicting effects and zero explicit dependencies -- EffectGraphBuilder::seal()'s automatic conflict detection produces the full C(4,2)=6-edge transitive closure, which is the only construction classify_effect_graph_shape recognizes as ForkJoin at node_count==4 (see ADR-027). The written allocation's final bytes are asserted against the deterministic topological order's last writer, which only holds if the per-node MTLFence scheme actually serializes the 4 encoders rather than racing.

correctness.tolerance: exact (encoder_count/barrier_count are exact integers; final buffer bytes are byte-exact against the deterministic-order last writer)

judgement: Metal's dispatch_effect_dag lowers exactly 3 of the 4 EffectGraphShape values to real, hardware-verified encoder/fence strategies (ADR-027, finalizing the backend-specific barrier merging and queue/encoder lowering ADR-008 deferred to Phase B): IndependentBranches (one encoder per pass, no fences, relying on the shape's own zero-conflict precondition), LinearChain (a single encoder, sequential in-encoder ordering), and ForkJoin (one encoder per pass, a fully general per-node MTLFence scheme keyed off actual graph.edges() predecessors -- not a source/join role split, since empirical construction showed the classifier's own edge-count invariant forces at least one direct middle-to-middle edge once node_count>3). The 4th bucket (Unsupported) is a first-class, honestly-reported outcome: a diamond construction with both explicit dependencies and overlapping conflicting effects between adjacent nodes produces duplicate Explicit+InferredConflict edges that inflate structural_edges past what the classifier recognizes, and compile() reports this honestly via an effect_dag_lowering report event classified LoweringClass::Unsupported rather than guessing a fence placement. Scope boundary (explicit, not a gap): cross-queue (a second MTLCommandQueue), representation-transition, and external-present shaped graphs are not among the 3 recognized shapes and are not attempted -- they fall into the same honest Unsupported bucket. Combining effect_dag_passes with task_graph in the same submission is out of scope for this milestone (ADR-027), mirroring ADR-026's identical Tier1/atomic_add scope boundary.
vulkan_status: compile-review-only (ADR-024); vulkan_device_hal.cpp does not act on effect_dag_passes at all -- a documentation-only comment block above DeviceHal::compile maps the same 3 in-scope shapes onto vkCmdPipelineBarrier2/multiple vkCmdDispatch calls, with zero functional change to actual Vulkan behavior (ADR-027)
